llm_response.reason: Multiple scam indicators: the website claims FCA regulation but provides no verifiable proof; domain owner details are inaccessible due to a failure of WHOIS lookup and an abuse ban, which suggests intentional obscuring of ownership; testimonials are generic and unverifiable; promises of passive income, guaranteed returns, instant withdrawal, and free signup specifically target psychological weaknesses; there is excessive marketing language and urgency tactics; company details are vague, with no evidence of real-world presence. These features match many published characteristics of scam investment sites.
